SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.arch_type, a.arch_module, a.fingerprint,
	               a.root_id, a.props, a.xmin::text
	        FROM anchors a WHERE a.id = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[]))

SELECT id FROM (SELECT t.id AS id, t.ord AS ord, t.tie AS tie FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) AS j(did) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.id AS id, (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint AS ord, (m.f_post_id #>> '{}')::bigint AS tie FROM g_n_post_d2a57d m WHERE m.dst_endpoint_hascreator = j.did AND (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint <= $2 ORDER BY (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint DESC, (m.f_post_id #>> '{}')::bigint ASC LIMIT $3) t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jac_ep_violation v WHERE v.tbl = $4 AND v.edge_type = $5) UNION ALL SELECT m.id AS id, (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint AS ord, (m.f_post_id #>> '{}')::bigint AS tie FROM anchors e JOIN g_n_post_d2a57d m ON m.id = e.src WHERE e.dst = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) AND e.arch_type = $5 AND e.src_type = $6 AND (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint <= $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jac_ep_violation v WHERE v.tbl = $4 AND v.edge_type = $5) UNION ALL SELECT t.id AS id, t.ord AS ord, t.tie AS tie FROM unnest(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) AS j(did) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.id AS id, (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint AS ord, (m.f_comment_id #>> '{}')::bigint AS tie FROM g_n_comment_d2a57d m WHERE m.dst_endpoint_hascreator = j.did AND (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint <= $2 ORDER BY (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint DESC, (m.f_comment_id #>> '{}')::bigint ASC LIMIT $3) t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jac_ep_violation v WHERE v.tbl = $7 AND v.edge_type = $5) UNION ALL SELECT m.id AS id, (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint AS ord, (m.f_comment_id #>> '{}')::bigint AS tie FROM anchors e JOIN g_n_comment_d2a57d m ON m.id = e.src WHERE e.dst = ANY(CAST($1 AS uuid[])) AND e.arch_type = $5 AND e.src_type = $8 AND (m.f_creationdate #>> '{}')::bigint <= $2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jac_ep_violation v WHERE v.tbl = $7 AND v.edge_type = $5)) u ORDER BY ord DESC, tie ASC LIMIT $3
